content_sections.heading: DCAC Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
DCAC Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DCAC Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the DCAC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Delhi College of Arts & Commerce recruitment is Guest Faculty. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Guest Faculty positions at Delhi College of Arts & Commerce.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly cap of Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Eligibility criteria are the same as for regular Assistant Professors as per UGC Regulations, with a minimum API Score of 55 marks and above.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should report one hour before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Resume, self-attested copies of certificates, and a recent photograph for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of Delhi College of Arts & Commerce?
faq.answer: The official website of Delhi College of Arts & Commerce is http://dcac.ac.in. You can find more information there.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Delhi College of Arts & Commerce office. The exact address is New Delhi, Delhi - 110023.
